about:
TFTD Workshop 2.12.7

Map and assembly editor, GEO procedural generator, PNG HD and REAL HD previews.

Language: French, English, Spanish, German. Tutorial: local interface and texture guide.

GEO saved as JMW4; MAP/OXCE export and direct GEO editing unavailable. No TFTD/OXCE assets included.

Thanks to GPT-6 Sol
